name: knowledge_query
description: Ask a natural-language question against the z-agent-knowledge RAG system. Returns an LLM-generated answer WITH citations to source documents (FEATURE013 R5: AnswerWithCitation). Use this when the CEO agent needs to retrieve lessons/strategies/specs semantically. Example queries: 'What did we learn about RAG costs?', 'Any past failures with over-engineering?', 'How did we handle z-mist audit log?'. The result includes `answer` (text), `citations` (array of source docCodes with chunk text), and `confidence` score. The base is identified by `knowledgeBaseCode` (default 'ceo_lessons' for ceo_room memory layer).

question.description: Natural-language question. Should be a real question (not a keyword search). e.g. '上次做 RAG 踩过什么坑？' or 'how to handle rate limit in z-mist?'

knowledgeBaseCode.description: Knowledge base to query. Default 'ceo_lessons' for ceo_room memory.

topK.description: Number of top chunks to retrieve before LLM generation. Default 5, max 20. Higher = more context but slower + costlier.

category.description: Optional: filter by category. e.g. 'what_fails' to only get failure lessons.
